heading: Track Your Shipment
subtext: Enter your shipment reference or Bill of Lading number to receive a real-time status update from our operations team.

howItWorksSteps.label: Submit Your Reference
howItWorksSteps.description: Enter your Bill of Lading or SSVT shipment reference and your contact email.

howItWorksSteps.label: Operations Review
howItWorksSteps.description: Our 24/7 operations team retrieves your real-time cargo status from our fleet management system.

howItWorksSteps.label: Status Delivered
howItWorksSteps.description: Receive a detailed status update by email within 2 hours, including current location and ETA.

seo.title: Track Your Shipment
seo.description: Track your SSVT Logistics shipment. Enter your Bill of Lading or reference number for a real-time status update from our 24/7 operations team.
